structured_output.title: Ingress pathType change may affect cert-manager HTTP-01 challenges
structured_output.content: cert-manager v1.17.0 is installed and generates Kubernetes Ingress resources for HTTP-01 certificate challenges. The upgrade changes Ingress `pathType` from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact`, altering how the ingress controller matches request paths. Inspect your ingress controller's support for `pathType: Exact`, verify no HTTP-01 workflows depend on `ImplementationSpecific` matching behavior, and monitor ingress controller logs post-upgrade for path-matching failures.
